sources.snippet: About Qwen3-30B-A3B Qwen3-30B-A3B is an efficient Mixture-of-Experts model from Alibaba Cloud activating 3.3B parameters per token for high-throughput reasoning. It features dual thinking modes and multilingual fluency across 119 languages over a 131K context window.
